node -e "const assert = require('node:assert/strict'); const {parseDuration: p} = require('./src/duration'); for (const [text, expected] of [['2d4h',187200000], ['1s2s',3000], ['30m1h',5400000], ['  1h30m\n',5400000], ['0ms',0], ['0.5ms',0.5], ['1ms1m1s1h1d',90061001]]) assert.equal(p(text), expected); for (const value of [null, undefined, {}, [], true, '', '   ', '1h 30m', '1h\n30m', '1H', '1MS', '1', '.5s', '1.s', '-1s', '+1s', '1e3s', '1s!', '1s2', '１s', '9'.repeat(400) + 'ms', '1' + '0'.repeat(308) + 'ms' + '1' + '0'.repeat(308) + 'ms']) assert.throws(() => p(value), TypeError); console.log('Additional grammar, summation, and overflow checks passed');"
node --test; node -e "const {createLimiter}=require('./src/limit'); createLimiter(1)(function () { return arguments.length; }).then(n => console.log('Task argument count:', n));"

node -e "'use strict'; const assert = require('node:assert/strict'); const { createLimiter } = require('./src/limit'); (async () => { for (const value of [0, -1, 1.5, NaN, Infinity, '2', null, undefined, 2n]) assert.throws(() => createLimiter(value), RangeError); const run = createLimiter(1); for (const value of [null, undefined, 42, {}]) { const result = run(value); assert.ok(result instanceof Promise); await assert.rejects(result, TypeError); } assert.equal(await run(function () { assert.equal(arguments.length, 0); assert.equal(this, undefined); return 7; }), 7); const error = new Error('expected'); const tasks = [run(() => { throw error; }), run(() => Promise.reject(error)), run(() => ({ get then() { throw error; } })), run(() => ({ then(resolve) { resolve(11); } })), run(() => 42)]; const results = await Promise.allSettled(tasks); for (const result of results.slice(0, 3)) { assert.equal(result.status, 'rejected'); assert.equal(result.reason, error); } assert.deepEqual(results.slice(3), [{ status: 'fulfilled', value: 11 }, { status: 'fulfilled', value: 42 }]); assert.equal(await run(() => 'usable'), 'usable'); console.log('Supplemental contract checks passed'); })().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });"

node -e "const assert = require('node:assert/strict'); const { LRUCache } = require('./src/lru'); for (const capacity of [0, -1, 1.5, Infinity, -Infinity, NaN, '2', undefined, null, true, 2n, {}, new Number(2), Symbol()]) assert.throws(() => new LRUCache(capacity), RangeError); assert.throws(() => new LRUCache(), RangeError); const c = new LRUCache(2); c.set('a', undefined).set('b', 2); assert.equal(c.get('a'), undefined); c.set('c', 3); assert.equal(c.has('a'), true); assert.equal(c.has('b'), false); c.set('a', 4); assert.equal(c.size, 2); assert.equal(c.has('c'), true); c.has('c'); c.get('missing'); c.set('d', 5); assert.equal(c.has('c'), false); assert.equal(c.get('a'), 4); const object = {}, symbol = Symbol(); const keys = new LRUCache(8); for (const key of [object, symbol, NaN, undefined, null, 0, '0', 1n]) keys.set(key, key); assert.equal(keys.size, 8); for (const key of [object, symbol, NaN, undefined, null, -0, '0', 1n]) assert.equal(keys.has(key), true); assert.equal(keys.has({}), false); keys.set(-0, 'zero'); assert.equal(keys.size, 8); assert.equal(keys.get(0), 'zero'); assert.equal(keys.get(NaN), NaN); const order = new LRUCache(3); order.set('a', 1).set('b', 2).set('c', 3); assert.equal(order.delete('b'), true); assert.equal(order.delete('missing'), false); order.set('d', 4).set('e', 5); assert.equal(order.has('a'), false); assert.equal(order.has('c'), true); const independent = new LRUCache(1); independent.set('a', 99).set('b', 100); assert.equal(independent.has('a'), false); assert.equal(independent.size, 1); assert.equal(c.get('a'), 4); console.log('Additional capacity, recency, key-semantics, deletion, and independence checks passed');"
